Title: Existence and Uniqueness of Direct Limit of Sequence of Groups/Lemma 3

Let $h_\infty: G_\infty \to H$ be the [[Definition:Mapping|mapping]] defined as:

:$\eqclass {\tuple {x_n, n} } {} \mapsto \map {h_n} {x_n}$

Then $h_\infty$ is a [[Definition:Well-Defined Mapping|well-defined]] [[Definition:Group Homomorphism|group homomorphism]].
